title: Partner Service-Level Terms: Rush Turnaround Charge (Cleaning and Damage Fees)
content:
**Rule.** The rush charge of a Wayfare partner work order on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report is read from the calendar days between the reported trip's drop-off date and the date the work order was put on the evidence ledger: one day or less takes the next-day rush charge; two or three days take the short-turnaround charge; more days take no rush charge.

| Calendar days from the drop-off date to the work order date | Rush charge |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | $35.00 next-day rush |
| 2 or 3 | $15.00 short turnaround |
| 4 or more | none |

- The drop-off date is the date of the drop-off moment on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).
- The work order date is the date of the cleaning receipt submission on the assessment's evidence ledger; where more than one is on the ledger, the latest.
- The days are counted as calendar dates, not as elapsed hours.

The rush charge is a fixed amount added to the work order's price.

## Date cases (hypothetical; drop-off on 4 March)

| Work order put on the evidence ledger | Days | Rush charge |
|---|---|---|
| 4 March | 0 | $35.00 |
| 5 March | 1 | $35.00 |
| 6 March | 2 | $15.00 |
| 7 March | 3 | $15.00 |
| 8 March | 4 | none |
